scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Find it in the dashboard overview.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: A scoped Cloudflare API token with RealtimeKit administration and Workers AI run permissions.

RTK_APP_ID.description: The RealtimeKit app ID created in the Cloudflare dashboard.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenRouter key used as a summary fallback. Leave blank to use the Cloudflare/Gemini path only.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional Gemini key for long-transcript summarization.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional Resend key for summary emails. Email delivery is disabled when no provider is configured.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional shared secret for RealtimeKit webhook requests.
